تعتزلن (form VIII)
# تَعْتَزِلْنَ (taʕtazilna) /taʕ.ta.zil.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past active indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِعْتَزَلَ (iʕtazala)
# تُعْتَزَلْنَ (tuʕtazalna) /tuʕ.ta.zal.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past passive indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِعْتَزَلَ (iʕtazala)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
